title: Ownership Ledger
prompt: An allocation ledger lives in your editor (`struct ent { const void *p; int freed; }; static struct ent ledger[16]; static size_t n_led;`). Implement `void own(const void *p)` (record), `void release(const void *p)` (mark freed; double-release must be detectable), and `int audit(void)` returning the count of leaked (never freed) entries — the shutdown check LSan performs.

tests.name: leak counting
tests.hint: Two live allocations, none freed: two leaks — the audit question answered.

tests.name: released entries do not leak
tests.hint: Marking freed before audit yields zero leaks.
